description: Follow-up evaluation on C01. Every required item is a canonical fact pattern (or several equivalent ones) produced by a graph operation, or a category the answer must name as not established by the P&ID. tests/test_followup.py re-derives every pattern from the graph.

questions.question: Which valves must be closed to isolate T4750 for maintenance? List them in the order you would close them, explain the order, and say which connections this drawing does not let you isolate.

required.fact: the line from SV 104.01 has no isolation valve

questions.notes: A P&ID does not encode a closure order; the answer must say so instead of giving one.

questions.question: How would you isolate H1007? If the drawing doesn't give you what you need, say what is missing.

required.fact: no valve between H1007 and P4711

line 47131 at PlateHeatExchanger-1 leaves the drawing (open end)
H1007 cannot be fully isolated with the valves drawn

questions.notes: Downstream reach and the instruments measuring on it are graph facts; that flow is lost or a reading changes is process behaviour.

questions.question: If the actuated valves lose their actuating power, what position does each one go to, and what happens to flow into T4750? Answer strictly from the diagram.

fail action of ActuatingFunction-2: fail close
fail action of ActuatingFunction-3: fail open
what remains connected with GlobeValve-2 treated as closed
what remains connected with GlobeValve-1 treated as closed

questions.notes: Encoded fail actions are direct facts; what stays connected with the fail-closed valves blocked is derived; actual flow is not in the drawing.

questions.notes: Whether a pressure reading rises or falls cannot be determined from a P&ID; the expected answer says so and gives the topology it can establish.

questions.question: Does H1008 have a path to a pressure relief device? What has to happen for that path to be open?

questions.notes: Two undirected routes join them: one through T4750 to the discharge side of the relief device, one against the drawn flow through 47126/C7 to its inlet. Whether that valve is open, and when the device lifts, is not in the P&ID.
